Additional team-building activity suggestions:

1. Escape Room Challenge
Split the team into small groups and have them solve puzzles together within a set time limit, either in person or virtually. This encourages collaboration, communication, and creative problem-solving.

2. Skill Swap Workshop
Invite team members to teach a short session on a skill or hobby they know well, such as photography, budgeting, design tips, or cooking basics. This helps colleagues learn more about one another while building appreciation for diverse strengths.
